_doc: The ground of a place. Creel's ground shader knows some of these by name (water, ford, tree, stump, rock: it lays leaf litter under 'tree' and 'stump'), which is why the giants are plain 'tree'. 'rubble' is a landslide's debris (#20): Creel lays scree under it. 'bare' is bare mountain ground, stony, nothing growing on it (Smyana paints its scree). A tree is an old giant: it blocks the way and can't be felled. A young_tree can be felled for wood and leaves a stump, which is how a place shows it was worked on the way home.
